extracted.intended_audience: SEAs, LEAs, Indian tribes, Indian organizations, Tribal Colleges or Universities, Bureau of Indian Education, community-based organizations, and other applicants for ESSA Indian education grant funds
extracted.subtask_description: An indexed guide of permissible uses of ESSA funds and related program requirements specific to Indian education (Title VI) and related ESSA programs; lists activities, conditions, and eligible entities for grant-funded services and programs for Indian students and communities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career preparation activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Career preparation activities to enable Indian students to participate in programs such as the programs supported by the Carl D. Perkins Career and Technical Education Act, including programs for tech-prep education, mentoring, and apprenticeship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes partnership projects between schools and local businesses for career preparation programs designed to provide Indian youth with the knowledge and skills they need to make an effective transition from school to a high-skill career.

rubrics_metrics.name: College preparation
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs designed to encourage and assist Indian students to work toward, and gain entrance into, institutions of higher education.

rubrics_metrics.name: Culturally related activities (program support)
rubrics_metrics.description: Culturally related activities that support the program described in the application submitted by the LEA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Activities must be tied to the program described in the LEA application (i.e., responsive to identified needs and plans in the grant application).

rubrics_metrics.name: Culturally related activities (elders/traditional leaders)
rubrics_metrics.description: Activities that recognize and support the unique cultural and educational needs of Indian children and youth, and incorporate appropriately qualified tribal elders and seniors or traditional leaders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs should incorporate tribal elders/seniors/traditional leaders as appropriate to serve cultural and educational needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Culturally responsive teaching and learning
rubrics_metrics.description: Activities that promote the incorporation of culturally responsive teaching and learning strategies into the educational program of the LEA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dropout prevention
rubrics_metrics.description: Dropout prevention strategies for Indian students.

rubrics_metrics.name: Educational services in academic subjects
rubrics_metrics.description: Educational services that are not available to Indian children and youth in sufficient quantity or quality, including remedial instruction, to raise the achievement of Indian children in one or more of the subjects of English, mathematics, science, foreign languages, art, history, and geography.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funds may be used to provide subject-matter instruction and remedial services where needed to meet challenging State academic standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enrichment programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Enrichment programs that focus on problem solving and cognitive skills development and directly support the attainment of challenging State academic standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment acquisition (conditional)
rubrics_metrics.description: The acquisition of equipment, but only if the acquisition of the equipment is essential to meeting the unique cultural, language, and educational needs of Indian students, and to ensuring that all students meet the challenging State academic standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Equipment purchases are permitted only when essential to meet unique needs and to ensure attainment of State academic standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluating federally assisted education programs from which Indian children and adults may benefit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Family literacy services
rubrics_metrics.description: Family literacy services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidance, counseling, and testing services
rubrics_metrics.description: Comprehensive guidance, counseling, and testing services.

rubrics_metrics.name: High school graduation supports
rubrics_metrics.description: Special compensatory and other programs and projects designed to assist and encourage Indian children and youth to enter, remain in, or reenter school, and to increase the rate of high school graduation for Indian children and youth.

rubrics_metrics.name: Programs for at-risk students in correctional facilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Strategies to meet the educational needs of at-risk Indian students in correctional facilities, including such strategies that support Indian students who are transitioning from such facilities to schools served by LEAs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes innovative programs related to the educational needs of educationally disadvantaged Indian children and youth.

rubrics_metrics.name: Native American language programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Activities that support Native American language programs and Native American language restoration programs, which may be taught by traditional leaders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parental and family engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Integrated educational services in combination with other programs that meet the needs of Indian children and their families, including programs that promote parental involvement in school activities and increase student achievement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional development for administrators
rubrics_metrics.description: Continuing education programs, symposia, workshops, and conferences; direct financial support; and programs designed to train traditional leaders and cultural experts to assist administrators, as appropriate, with relevant Native language and cultural mentoring, guidance, and support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional development for counselors
rubrics_metrics.description: Continuing education programs, symposia, workshops, and conferences; direct financial support; and programs designed to train traditional leaders and cultural experts to assist counselors, as appropriate, with relevant Native language and cultural mentoring, guidance, and support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional development for paraprofessionals
rubrics_metrics.description: High-quality professional development of teaching professionals and paraprofessionals; continuing education programs, symposia, workshops, and conferences; direct financial support; and programs designed to train traditional leaders and cultural experts to assist paraprofessionals, as appropriate, with relevant Native language and cultural mentoring, guidance, and support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional development for principals and other school leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: Continuing education programs, symposia, workshops, and conferences; direct financial support; and programs designed to train traditional leaders and cultural experts to assist principals or other school leaders, as appropriate, with relevant Native language and cultural mentoring, guidance, and support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional development for teachers (mentoring, induction)
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing professional development for teachers and, as appropriate, staff and administrators to strengthen the overall language and academic goals of the school; teacher mentoring programs, professional guidance, and instructional support provided by educators, local traditional leaders, or cultural experts, as appropriate for teachers during their first 3 years of employment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes both general PD to strengthen school goals and targeted supports (mentoring) for early-career teachers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research on effective approaches
rubrics_metrics.description: Conducting research related to effective approaches for the education of Indian children and adults.

rubrics_metrics.name: Safe and healthy students (prevention and services)
rubrics_metrics.description: Activities to educate individuals so as to prevent violence, suicide, and substance abuse; special health and nutrition services, and other related activities, that address the special health, social, and psychological problems of Indian children and youth.

rubrics_metrics.name: School readiness (early childhood)
rubrics_metrics.description: Early childhood and family programs that emphasize school readiness; early childhood education programs that are effective in preparing young children to make sufficient academic growth by the end of grade 3, including kindergarten and pre-kindergarten programs, family-based preschool programs that emphasize school readiness, screening and referral.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schoolwide programs (Indian students)
rubrics_metrics.description: Schoolwide programs, if approved by a representative committee defined under ESSA, that are designed to meet the unique cultural, language, and educational needs of Indian students, and the LEA identifies in its application how the use of such funds in a schoolwide program will produce benefits to Indian students that would not be achieved if the funds were not used in a schoolwide program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use in schoolwide programs requires representative committee approval and explicit LEA justification of additional benefit for Indian students.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collecting and analyzing statistics
rubrics_metrics.description: Collecting and analyzing data on the educational status and needs of Indians.

rubrics_metrics.name: Services for students with disabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Services to Indian children and youth with disabilities (including services for individuals with disabilities).

rubrics_metrics.name: Transition from secondary to postsecondary education
rubrics_metrics.description: Partnership projects between LEAs and institutions of higher education that allow secondary school students to enroll in courses at the postsecondary level to aid such students in the transition from secondary to postsecondary education.

rubrics_metrics.name: Carry out comprehensive LEA program described in application
rubrics_metrics.description: Carrying out the comprehensive program of the LEA for Indian students as described in the application the LEA submitted to the Secretary solely for the services and activities described in the application, which are designed to be responsive to the language and cultural needs of the Indian students, and that supplement and enrich the regular school program of the LEA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funds must be used solely for the services/activities in the approved LEA application and must supplement/enrich the regular school program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Planning and developing a tribal educational agency
rubrics_metrics.description: Planning and developing a tribal educational agency, if the tribe or organization has no current tribal educational agency, for a period of not more than 1 year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct administration of education programs by tribes/organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Directly administering education programs, including formula grant programs under ESSA, consistent with State law and under a written agreement between the parties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Direct administration must be consistent with State law and be set out in a written agreement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Building administrative and coordination capacity
rubrics_metrics.description: Building capacity to administer and coordinate education programs, and to improve the relationship and coordination between applicants and the SEAs and LEAs that educate students from the tribe.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training and support from SEA/LEA (capacity building)
rubrics_metrics.description: Receiving training and support from the SEA and LEA, in areas such as data collection and analysis, grants management and monitoring, fiscal accountability, and other areas as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training/support for SEA and LEA in tribal history/language/culture
rubrics_metrics.description: Training and supporting the SEA and LEA in areas related to tribal history, language, or culture.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build on existing activities/resources (non-supplanting)
rubrics_metrics.description: Building on existing activities or resources rather than replacing other funds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funds should not supplant existing resources; they should build on and expand current activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Native language education and development (curriculum & assessment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting Native American or Alaska Native language education and development; developing or refining curriculum, including teaching materials and activities; creating or refining assessments written in the Native American or Alaska Native language of instruction that measure student proficiency and that are aligned with State or tribal academic standards; carrying out other activities that promote the maintenance and revitalization of the Native American or Alaska Native language relevant to the grant program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes curriculum development and assessment design in Native languages, alignment with standards, and language maintenance/revitalization activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Induction and mentoring programs (teachers/leaders)
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing, or assisting LEAs in developing new teacher, principal, or other school leader induction and mentoring programs that are, to the extent the State determines that such evidence is reasonably available, evidence-based, and designed to improve classroom instruction and student learning and achievement, including through improving school leadership programs; and/or designed to increase the retention of effective teachers, principals, or other school leaders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Induction/mentoring programs should be evidence-based to the extent feasible and target improved instruction, student outcomes, and retention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Literacy development: family engagement and adolescent literacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Engaging families and encouraging family literacy experiences and practices to support literacy development; training families and caregivers to support the improvement of adolescent literacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive adolescent literacy instruction (grades 6–12)
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing and implementing a comprehensive literacy instruction plan across content areas for children in grades 6 through 12 that serves the needs of all children, including children with disabilities and English learners; provides intensive, supplemental, accelerated, and explicit intervention and support in reading and writing for children whose literacy skills are below grade level; and supports activities that are provided primarily during the regular school day but that may be augmented by after-school and out-of-school time instruction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include assessment of instruction quality, dedicated planning time for teachers to plan evidence-based adolescent comprehensive literacy instruction, and coordination among principals, instructional leaders, teachers, literacy teams, ESL specialists, paraprofessionals, special educators, and specialized instructional support personnel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovation and research (development & rigorous evaluation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing, implementing, and testing the feasibility of a program which prior research suggests has promise; implementing and rigorously evaluating a program that has been successfully implemented under an early-phase grant or other effort meeting similar criteria; implementing and rigorously evaluating a program for replication that has been found to produce sizable, important impacts under a mid-phase grant or other effort meeting similar criteria, to determine replication and sustainability and identify conditions in which the program is most effective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluation should measure impact and cost effectiveness where possible, using existing administrative data when feasible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expanded library service hours
rubrics_metrics.description: Expanded library service hours.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities include LEAs, community-based organizations, Indian tribes or tribal organizations, other public or private entities, or a consortium of 2 or more entities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Licensing/certification reforms for teachers and leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: Reforming principal or other school leader certification, recertification, licensing, or tenure systems or preparation program standards and approval processes to ensure principals/school leaders have instructional leadership skills; reforming teacher certification/licensing/tenure systems to ensure teachers have necessary subject-matter knowledge and teaching skills as demonstrated through State-determined measures (which may include teacher performance assessments); aligning teacher certification/licensing requirements with State academic standards; enabling interstate reciprocity for licensed/certified teachers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include measures such as teacher performance assessments; States may develop voluntary interstate processes to allow teaching across participating States without additional requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Literacy coaches (recruiting, training, compensating)
rubrics_metrics.description: Recruiting, placing, training, and compensating literacy coaches; developing literacy coach training programs and training literacy coaches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible entities and program specifics vary by grant (e.g., Comprehensive Literacy Development Grants).
